heading: Our Little Universe
lines: To Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💙, who makes my world a little more beautiful...
I hope the world is gentle with you.
I hope you receive the love you so freely give.
I hope you achieve everything you dream of.
I hope you never question how wonderful you are.
You deserve all the happiness, kindness, success, and love in this universe.
And if I had to choose one of the best things that ever happened to me...
I'd choose meeting you, again and again.
hiddenMessage: P.S. If you found this, Chuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuba 💜, you're officially the most curious person I know. I love you! Text me. 💜
